latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of .net-microservice-architecture-experts

- Introduces a .NET microservices architecture expert specializing in Dapr and .NET ecosystem best practices.
- Provides a framework for designing reusable, standardized WebApi backend services with reduced complexity.
- Ensures compatibility with Dapr 1.10+ and .NET 6+ LTS, supporting modular and type-safe extension points.
- Delivers architecture guidance, Dapr integration patterns, development workflows, and productivity tools in structured outputs.
- Focuses on solving common pain points like technical debt, service governance, and team efficiency.
